note: IMS Options Widget is a single field widget plugin ImsOptionsWidget (id 'ims_options_select', label 'IMS select list') extending core OptionsSelectWidget. It moves already-selected options to the top of the option list so selection order is preserved (pairs with improved_multi_select 'orderable'). Applies to entity_reference, list_integer, list_float, list_string; multiple_values=TRUE; does NOT support optgroups. No settings, no configure route, no config schema, no permissions, no Drush, no plugin types. Its only persistent state is the widget 'type' on a field component in an entity_form_display config entity. Medium/hard cases are grounded in that real form-display config: introspection reads back which field uses the ims_options_select widget; execution switches a list field's widget to ims_options_select, verified against the live entity_form_display. Scripts create/remove namespaced list fields (with allowed_values) on Article.

evals.prompt: What is the machine name and label of the field widget that the ims_options_widget module adds, and which core widget does it extend?
evals.expected_output: It adds the 'IMS select list' widget (id ims_options_select), which extends core's OptionsSelectWidget.

evals.prompt: What does the ims_options_widget 'IMS select list' widget do differently from the standard select-list widget, and why is that useful with improved_multi_select?
evals.expected_output: It moves the currently selected options to the top of the option list (in stored order), so when improved_multi_select's 'Allow re-ordering of selected items' (orderable) is on, the picked order is preserved on the edit form.

evals.prompt: Which field types can use the ims_options_select widget, and does it support optgroups?
evals.expected_output: It applies to entity_reference, list_integer, list_float and list_string fields. It does NOT support optgroups (supportsGroups() returns FALSE; grouped values are flattened).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value list field field_imsw_known configured with the ims_options_widget module. Inspect the live default form display and give the exact widget type (machine name) it uses.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_imsw_known component uses widget type ims_options_select. Read via drush cget core.entity_form_display.node.article.default content.field_imsw_known.

evals.prompt: The Article content type on this site has two list fields, field_imsw_a and field_imsw_b. Exactly one of them uses the IMS select list widget (ims_options_select); the other uses the core select-list widget. Inspect the live form display and state which field uses the IMS select list widget.
evals.expected_output: field_imsw_a uses widget type ims_options_select; field_imsw_b uses options_select. Read core.entity_form_display.node.article.default.

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value list (text) field field_imsw_task that currently uses the core select-list widget. Using the ims_options_widget module, change its default form-display widget to the 'IMS select list' (ims_options_select). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_imsw_task component has type=ims_options_select (set via Manage form display or setComponent).

evals.prompt: On this Drupal site, the Article content type has a multi-value list (integer) field field_imsw_pri currently using the core select-list widget. Use the ims_options_widget module to switch its default form-display widget to the IMS select list (ims_options_select). Apply the change to the live site.
evals.expected_output: In core.entity_form_display.node.article.default the field_imsw_pri component has type=ims_options_select.
